Lucy Connolly, serving 31 months for posting on X during the UK riots, has been denied temporary release - despite meeting eligibility criteria and having no violent record.
Her post, deleted within hours, was branded as inciting violence, but critics say her punishment reflects "two-tier justice" and political pressure.
Connolly’s husband is seriously ill, and her 12-year-old daughter is struggling - yet her application is delayed over fears of media backlash.
Her appeal is set for May 15, as free speech advocates call the case a chilling precedent.
Source: Daily Mail
